# FuelFlux ST Bitmap

`FuelFlux ST Bitmap` is a Modified Version generated from the native
`ter-u12n.bdf` and `ter-u28b.bdf` strikes in Terminus Font 4.49.1.

- Original copyright: Copyright (C) 2020 Dimitar Toshkov Zhekov
- Original project: https://terminus-font.sourceforge.net/
- Source archive: `terminus-font-4.49.1.tar.gz`
- Source SHA-256: `D961C1B781627BF417F9B340693D64FC219E0113AD3A3AF1A3424C7AA373EF79`
- License: SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (`OFL.txt`)

The generated data is named `FuelFlux ST Bitmap` because “Terminus Font” is
a Reserved Font Name under the OFL. The generated data includes the printable
ASCII range and glyphs available in the Unicode Cyrillic block.
